description: Frontend admin (frontend/src/admin/AdminApp.jsx): complete the EVENTS editor and add a FORMATIONS (lineup) editor. Extend the existing EventsModule so admins can EDIT existing events (not just add/delete) and can set the new substitution/assist secondary player and the team side. Add a new FormationsModule that lets a Match Manager build the lineup for a match by selecting players from the match team, marking starters vs bench (Substitute), position order, position label, and captain, then saving via the existing PUT /api/admin/matches/{id}/lineup. All new UI is in FRENCH, uses existing Tailwind patterns and the Field/api helpers, and shows loading/empty/error states. Keep changes localized to events/formations (this delegation owns admin match events/lineups; do not restructure unrelated modules).
steps: Read frontend/src/admin/AdminApp.jsx to reuse: the api(path, options) helper (~line 5), the Field component (~line 62), the EventsModule (~line 184), the MatchesModule reference-loading pattern (~line 349, uses api('/admin/matches/references')), and the nav/section wiring (~lines 259-262 and the section render switch ~300-304).

In EventsModule: extend the form state to include secondaryPlayerName and team (e.g. {minute:0,type:'Goal',playerName:'',secondaryPlayerName:'',team:'',notes:''}). Add inputs: a 'Joueur entrant / passeur' Field bound to secondaryPlayerName (label it clearly in French, e.g. shown for Substitution/Goal), and a 'Camp' select with options for none / Domicile (value 'Home') / Extérieur (value 'Away'). Add EDIT support: an 'edit' button per listed event that loads the event into the form and switches the submit into update mode; the submit handler calls PUT /admin/matches/{selected}/events/{editingId} when editing, otherwise POST as today. Add a way to cancel editing that resets the form. Convert minute with Number(). Render the secondary player and team in the event list rows (in French) when present. Preserve the existing delete behavior and empty state ('Aucun événement enregistré.').

Add a new FormationsModule({ onError }) component modeled on EventsModule/MatchesModule: load matches via api('/admin/matches'); on selecting a match, load its current lineup via api('/admin/matches/'+id+'/lineup') and load the eligible players for that match's team. To get players, first fetch the match to know its teamId (the match objects from /admin/matches include teamId per the Match entity) then call api('/admin/teams/'+teamId+'/players'). Present the roster: for each player allow toggling inclusion, choosing Role ('Starter'=Titulaire / 'Substitute'=Remplaçant), an optional position label (Position) and positionOrder (numeric), and an isCaptain checkbox (enforce at most one captain in the UI). Build the payload { items: [{ playerId, role, positionOrder, position, isCaptain }] } and save via api('/admin/matches/'+selected+'/lineup', { method:'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) }). After save, reload the lineup. Show loading, empty ('Aucune formation enregistrée.' / 'Sélectionne un match.'), and error states; route errors through onError like other modules. Use French labels throughout and the same Tailwind card/button classes (rounded-[1.5rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6, bg-jso-navy text-white buttons, Field component, lucide icons already imported such as Save, Plus, X, Pencil).

Wire the new module into navigation: in the sections array (~line 259-262) add an entry for formations, e.g. ['formations', 'Formations', Trophy, ['SuperAdmin','ClubAdmin','MatchManager']] placed near 'events'. In the render switch (~line 300-304) add {section === 'formations' && <FormationsModule onError={setError}/>}. Reuse an already-imported lucide icon (e.g. Trophy or Users) to avoid adding new imports unless needed; if a new icon is used, add it to the existing lucide-react import line.

Keep the whole file style consistent (this file uses dense one-line components in places and expanded ones elsewhere; match the surrounding module you are editing). Do not touch unrelated modules (Sponsors, News, Media, Teams, Settings) beyond the nav array additions.
Ensure oxlint passes: no unused variables, no undeclared identifiers; only import icons that are used.
acceptance_criteria: EventsModule supports editing an existing event via PUT (in addition to add/delete), and can set secondaryPlayerName and team (Home/Away/none); the event list displays these fields in French when present.

A FormationsModule exists, is reachable from the admin nav (French label 'Formations'), lets the user pick a match, edit starters/bench/position/captain from the match team's players, and save via PUT /api/admin/matches/{id}/lineup, then reloads.
All new UI text is in French and uses existing Tailwind/Field/api patterns with loading, empty, and error states.
cd frontend && npm run build succeeds and cd frontend && npm run lint (oxlint) reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
verification: Confirm both complete with 0 errors/0 warnings and that AdminApp.jsx contains a FormationsModule and events edit (PUT) logic.
findings: Implemented in frontend/src/admin/AdminApp.jsx. EventsModule now supports edit-via-PUT (Pencil button per row loads event into form, submit toggles between POST create and PUT /admin/matches/{id}/events/{eventId}), plus new 'Joueur entrant'/'Passeur' field bound to secondaryPlayerName (shown for Goal/Substitution, label switches) and a 'Camp' select (Aucun / Domicile=Home / Extérieur=Away). Empty/nullable values sent as null; minute coerced with Number(). Event list rows render team badge and secondary player in French; 'Aucun événement enregistré.' empty state preserved; delete preserved with cancel-on-delete-of-editing. Added FormationsModule: picks a match, loads current lineup via GET /admin/matches/{id}/lineup and roster via /admin/teams/{teamId}/players (teamId from match objects), toggles inclusion, Role select (Titulaire=Starter/Remplaçant=Substitute), Position label, positionOrder numeric, single-captain enforcement, saves { items:[{playerId,role,positionOrder,position,isCaptain}] } via PUT then reloads. Loading/empty ('Sélectionne un match.' / 'Aucune formation enregistrée.')/error(onError) states present. Nav: added ['formations','Formations',Users,['SuperAdmin','ClubAdmin','MatchManager']] and render-switch case; reused already-imported Users icon (no new imports). Verification: `npm run build` -> vite v6.4.1, 1580 modules, built in 1.52s, exit 0. `npm run lint` (oxlint) -> Found 0 warnings and 0 errors, exit 0.
